video.description: The custom link preview video (og:video). Will be used for Custom Link Previews if `proxy` is true. Learn more: https://d.to/og

rewrite.description: Whether the short link uses link cloaking. Defaults to `false` if not provided.

ios.description: The iOS destination URL for the short link for iOS device targeting.

android.description: The Android destination URL for the short link for Android device targeting.

doIndex.description: Allow search engines to index your short link. Defaults to `false` if not provided. Learn more: https://d.to/noindex

url.description: The destination URL of the short link.

key.description: The short link slug. If not provided, a random 7-character slug will be generated.

programId.description: The ID of the program the short link is associated with.

partnerId.description: The ID of the partner the short link is associated with.

trackConversion.description: Whether to track conversions for the short link. Defaults to `false` if not provided.

archived.description: Whether the short link is archived. Defaults to `false` if not provided.

tagIds.description: The unique IDs of the tags assigned to the short link.

tagNames.description: The unique name of the tags assigned to the short link (case insensitive).

folderId.description: The unique ID existing folder to assign the short link to.

comments.description: The comments for the short link.

expiresAt.description: The date and time when the short link will expire at.

expiredUrl.description: The URL to redirect to when the short link has expired.

password.description: The password required to access the destination URL of the short link.

proxy.description: Whether the short link uses Custom Link Previews feature. Defaults to `false` if not provided.

title.description: The custom link preview title (og:title). Will be used for Custom Link Previews if `proxy` is true. Learn more: https://d.to/og

description.description: The custom link preview description (og:description). Will be used for Custom Link Previews if `proxy` is true. Learn more: https://d.to/og

image.description: The custom link preview image (og:image). Will be used for Custom Link Previews if `proxy` is true. Learn more: https://d.to/og

video.description: The custom link preview video (og:video). Will be used for Custom Link Previews if `proxy` is true. Learn more: https://d.to/og

rewrite.description: Whether the short link uses link cloaking. Defaults to `false` if not provided.

ios.description: The iOS destination URL for the short link for iOS device targeting.

android.description: The Android destination URL for the short link for Android device targeting.

doIndex.description: Allow search engines to index your short link. Defaults to `false` if not provided. Learn more: https://d.to/noindex

utm_source.description: The UTM source of the short link. If set, this will populate or override the UTM source in the destination URL.

utm_medium.description: The UTM medium of the short link. If set, this will populate or override the UTM medium in the destination URL.

utm_campaign.description: The UTM campaign of the short link. If set, this will populate or override the UTM campaign in the destination URL.

utm_term.description: The UTM term of the short link. If set, this will populate or override the UTM term in the destination URL.

ref.description: The referral tag of the short link. If set, this will populate or override the `ref` query parameter in the destination URL.

tools.name: get_link_stats
tools.description: Retrieve analytics for a link, a domain, or the authenticated workspace. The response type depends on the `event` and `type` query parameters.

event.description: The type of event to retrieve analytics for. Defaults to `clicks`.

group_by.description: The parameter to group the analytics data points by. Defaults to `count` if undefined.

domain.description: The domain to filter analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `dub.co`, `dub.co,google.com`, `-spam.com`.

key.description: The slug of the short link to retrieve analytics for. Must be used along with the corresponding `domain` of the short link to fetch analytics for a specific short link.

link_id.description: The unique ID of the link to retrieve analytics for.Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `link_123`, `link_123,link_456`, `-link_789`.

external_id.description: The ID of the link in the your database. Must be prefixed with 'ext_' when passed as a query parameter.

tenant_id.description: The ID of the tenant that created the link inside your system. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `tenant_123`, `tenant_123,tenant_456`, `-tenant_789`.

tag_id.description: The tag ID to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `tag_123`, `tag_123,tag_456`, `-tag_789`.

folder_id.description: The folder ID to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `folder_123`, `folder_123,folder_456`, `-folder_789`. If not provided, return analytics for all links.

partner_tag_id.description: The partner tag ID(s) to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `ptag_123`, `ptag_123,ptag_456`, `-ptag_789`.

group_id.description: The group ID to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `grp_123`, `grp_123,grp_456`, `-grp_789`.

partner_id.description: The ID of the partner to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `pn_123`, `pn_123,pn_456`, `-pn_789`.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to retrieve analytics for.

interval.description: The interval to retrieve analytics for. If undefined, defaults to 24h.

start.description: The start date and time when to retrieve analytics from. If set, takes precedence over `interval`.

end.description: The end date and time when to retrieve analytics from. If not provided, defaults to the current date. If set along with `start`, takes precedence over `interval`.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone code for aligning timeseries granularity (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to UTC.

country.description: The country to retrieve analytics for. Must be passed as a 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code (see https://d.to/geo). Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `US`, `US,BR,FR`, `-US`.

city.description: The city to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `New York`, `New York,London`, `-New York`.

region.description: The ISO 3166-2 region code to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `NY`, `NY,CA`, `-NY`.

continent.description: The continent to retrieve analytics for. Valid values: AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `NA`, `NA,EU`, `-AS`.

device.description: The device to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `Desktop`, `Mobile,Tablet`, `-Mobile`.

browser.description: The browser to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `Chrome`, `Chrome,Firefox,Safari`, `-IE`.

os.description: The OS to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `Windows`, `Mac,Windows,Linux`, `-Windows`.

trigger.description: The trigger to retrieve analytics for. Valid values: qr, link, pageview. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `qr`, `qr,link`, `-qr`. If undefined, returns all trigger types.

event_name.description: The conversion event name to retrieve analytics for. Only available for lead and sale events. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `Sign up`, `Sign up,Purchase`, `-Sign up`.

referer.description: The referer hostname to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `google.com`, `google.com,twitter.com`, `-facebook.com`.

referer_url.description: The full referer URL to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `https://google.com`, `https://google.com,https://twitter.com`, `-https://spam.com`.

url.description: The destination URL to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `https://example.com`, `https://example.com,https://other.com`, `-https://spam.com`.

utm_source.description: The UTM source to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `google`, `google,twitter`, `-spam`.

utm_medium.description: The UTM medium to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `cpc`, `cpc,social`, `-email`.

utm_campaign.description: The UTM campaign to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`). Examples: `summer_sale`, `summer_sale,winter_sale`, `-old_campaign`.

utm_term.description: The UTM term to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`).

utm_content.description: The UTM content to retrieve analytics for. Supports advanced filtering: single value, multiple values (comma-separated), or exclusion (prefix with `-`).

root.description: Filter for root domains. If true, filter for domains only. If false, filter for links only. If undefined, return both.

sale_type.description: Filter sales by type: 'new' for first-time purchases, 'recurring' for repeat purchases. If undefined, returns both.

query.description: Search the events by a custom metadata value. Only available for lead and sale events. Examples: `metadata['key']:'value'`
